name: Dr Sarah Ashton
title: Psychologist
description: Dr Sarah Ashton (she/her) is the Director and Founder of SHIPS, the first organisation dedicated to inclusive, trauma-informed, evidence-based sexual health psychology treatment. She is also the Founder and Lead Trainer for The Institute of Sexual Health Psychology Australia (ISHPA). She is a registered psychologist (AHPRA), a board-approved supervisor, and a member of the Society of Australian Sexologists. Dr Ashton lectures at RMIT and Deakin University and recently co-authored Deakin’s first Sex and Sexuality Unit. Her research on pornography has been published in The Journal of Sex Research, Porn Studies, and Feminism and Psychology.
specialties: Dissociative Identity Disorder, Sex worker issues, Diverse genders, Sexual abuse, Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Diverse sexualities, Gender Dysphoria, Sexual difficulties, Schema Therapy, EMDR

name: Dr Elizabeth Short
title: Psychologist
description: Dr Elizabeth Short is a clinical and community psychologist with over 30 years experience, assisting people who've experienced loss, discrimination, and/or trauma, and with the full range of issues. With Medicare, she is a provider of services in relation to pregnancy, birth, and early parenting. She works with people from diverse cultures and backgrounds, including refugee, Indigenous, and LGBTQIA+. Her approach is attachment-aware, trauma-informed, systemic, strengths-based, and respectful.
specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Diverse genders, Sexual abuse, Diverse sexualities, Schema Therapy

name: Tahlia Foley
title: Contact Psychologist
description: I have over a decade of experience working with young people and adults across a variety of settings. I have experience supporting children, adolescents and adults through transitions, as well as knowledge of assessment and counselling approaches for common mental health conditions. I use a range of therapeutic approaches based upon the needs of the individual, including Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT), Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT) and Schema Therapy.

name: Dr Danielle Williamson
title: Psychologist
description: Danielle is a registered clinical psychologist who works with adults from diverse age groups, cultural backgrounds, and sexual orientation. Danielle has a particular interest in psychoanalytic psychotherapy. This form of treatment can be effective for a wide range of presenting concerns, including grief and bereavement, trauma, anxiety, depression, relationship issues, sexuality, life transitions and changes, and identity concerns.
specialties: Diverse sexualities, Sexual abuse, Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Diverse genders

name: Ruby Shirrefs
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: I am a registered Clinical Psychologist with Masters level training in Clinical Psychology. My clinical experience is with individuals and families across the lifespan in private, inpatient, and community settings. I work with individuals experiencing a broad range of issues, but particularly with mood and anxiety disorders, PTSD and trauma-related disorders, and health-related concerns.
specialties: Diverse genders, Diverse sexualities, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), EMDR, Schema Therapy

name: Owen O'Neil
title: Psychologist
description: Owen is an endorsed counselling psychologist who enjoys working with members of the LGBTIQAP+, brotherboy and sistergirl communities, people who have experienced trauma, and people who struggle with their drug and alcohol use. Owen is sex, kink, and sex-work positive. He has a keen interest in relationship counselling, especially with queer couples and people in poly and CNM relationships. Owen takes a strengths-based approach and employs a range of therapeutic modalities including Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT), Eye Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing (EMDR), Emotionally Focused Therapy (EFT), Internal Family Systems (IFS), and Narrative Therapy. Owen is a proud member of the LGBTIQAP+ community and his pronouns are he/him/his.
specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Diverse genders, Sex worker issues, Diverse sexualities, Sexual abuse, Dissociative Identity Disorder, Gender Dysphoria, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), EMDR

name: Dr Jonathan Kettle
title: Psychologist
description: Previously the Head of Clinical Practice at The Cairnmillar Institute, I am a clinical psychologist with expertise in depression, anxiety, trauma, abuse, post-traumatic stress, relationships, substance use, ADHD & ASD, and gender & sexuality issues. I work with adults, adolescents and couples, and am also a senior lecturer at The Cairnmillar Institute.
specialties: Diverse genders, Gender Dysphoria, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Sexual abuse, Diverse sexualities, Sexual difficulties

name: Andrew St Lawrence
title: Contact Psychologist
description: My curious and authentic approach is focused around helping people make sense of their problems, and regain a sense of control over their life. While I support people in feeling better, I prioritise working together to build lasting wellbeing. I work with a range of people with various forms of suffering, from anxiety and depression, to PTSD, phobias, disordered eating, complex trauma, and adjustment to life transitions.
specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Diverse genders, Sexual abuse, Diverse sexualities
